rows.name: TRON_BENCHMARK_CACHE_ROOT

problems.statement: Job `benchmark` passes `--force` on the second and later run attempts.
problems.code_says: Two workflows have a job named benchmark. Only the one in gcp-nix.yml runs run_benchmark.sh, which reads this variable. The job benchmark of cmake-single-platform.yml passes --force to ci-run-benchmark.sh, which uses the fixed directory /scratch/test/cache.

cells.Set by: `bin/ci/tron-build/test_benchmark_runtime.py`, for a test. No workflow sets it.
cells.Values and default: Absolute path of a directory. The helper `ci-shared-nfs.sh ensure-dir` rejects a relative path and a symbolic link. It creates a missing directory and sets the mode to `777`. Unset: `/scratch/test/cache`.
cells.Effect: `run_benchmark.sh` (the CI benchmark script) keeps each result here as `benchmark.<result identity>.json`. When that regular file exists, the script copies it to the result path. It does not measure again. The option `--force` removes the cached file and measures again. Job `benchmark` of `gcp-nix.yml` passes `--force` on the second and later run attempts. The result identity is a SHA-256 hash of the payload identity, the source hash, the machine class and the host identity.

rows.name: TRON_BENCHMARK_DIR

cells.Values and default: Path of an existing directory. `benchmark_save.py` does not create the directory and does not check the path. Unset: `/scratch/tron-benchmark`. Empty: `benchmark_save.py` uses the empty text, and the result file path starts at the root directory `/`.

rows.name: LANG

problems.statement: It passes `LANG` of the submitting shell to that job.
problems.code_says: The script passes ${LANG:-C.UTF-8}. When LANG is unset or empty in the submitting shell, the remote job gets C.UTF-8, not an empty or missing LANG.
